title: Explain “domicile” in plain words, with the local term
pattern: Certificate that shows you live in this state (Domicile / Niwas praman patra)

N.note: First-time applicants understood it without help.

P.note: Read aloud by an operator, the Hindi term was dropped and the meaning was lost.

title: Say plainly that this step is free
context: Scholarship portal, any step that could be mistaken for a payment request
pattern: This step is free. No one from the office will ask you for money.

title: Reassure that answers can still be changed
pattern: You can still change your answers after this step, until the last date.

title: Show every required document on the first screen
pattern: One checklist of all required documents before the first upload, so nothing is asked for twice.

P.note: Operator could read the list aloud and tick items with the applicant.
